projects.title: Sepedi Sentiment Analysis
projects.description: AI-powered sentiment analysis for an underrepresented language.
projects.fullDescription: This project involved developing a bespoke machine learning model to analyze sentiment in Sepedi text. By training on a custom-curated dataset, the model achieves high accuracy, contributing to the digital preservation and technological empowerment of South African languages. projects.title: Biko Knowledge Graph
projects.description: Visualizing the network of the Black Consciousness Movement.
projects.fullDescription: A comprehensive knowledge graph mapping relationships between key figures, concepts, and institutions in the Black Consciousness Movement. This interactive visualization allows for an intuitive exploration of a complex historical and philosophical network. Drag the nodes to explore.

projects.title: Remnants of Rhodes
projects.description: A photographic exploration of post-colonial landscapes and identity.
projects.fullDescription: This series, shot on medium format film, investigates the lingering presence of colonial monuments and symbols within contemporary South African landscapes. It seeks to question how these remnants shape our present-day identity and our relationship with the past. Each photograph is a quiet confrontation with history.

projects.title: Vans SA Campaign
projects.description: Capturing authentic street culture for a global brand.
projects.fullDescription: A commercial campaign for Vans South Africa focused on authentic street photography. The brief was to move away from staged shots and capture the genuine energy of local skateboarding culture. The campaign involved shooting in multiple cities and resulted in a series of images used across digital and print platforms.
